params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $hits=@(); Get-ChildItem -Path $HOME -Directory -Force | ForEach-Object { $p=$_.FullName; if(Test-Path (Join-Path $p '.git')) { $u=(git -C $p remote get-url origin 2>$null); if($u -match 'fengie/mhw-mods') { $hits += $p } }; Get-ChildItem -Path $p -Directory -Force | ForEach-Object { $q=$_.FullName; if(Test-Path (Join-Path $q '.git')) { $u=(git -C $q remote get-url origin 2>$null); if($u -match 'fengie/mhw-mods') { $hits += $q } } } }; $hits=$hits|Select-Object -Unique; if(-not $hits){ Write-Output 'NO_CANONICAL_CLONE_FOUND' } else { foreach($p in $hits){ Write-Output ('REPO='+$p); git -C $p branch --show-current; git -C $p status --short; git -C $p rev-parse HEAD; git -C $p rev-parse origin/main 2>$null; Write-Output '---' } }
